title.narrative: The urgent response to the earthquake victims in Syria as part of the popular campaign to provide relief to those affected by the earthquake in Syria and Turkey

description.narrative: Delivery of urgent relief aid to the Syrian Red Crescent for distribution by them to the affected 40,206 Syrian beneficiaries

Operating (3) relief planes carrying (810 cartons of food baskets, 255 tents, 1152 large blankets, 84 small blankets, 60 shelter bags, and 35,460 baby formula boxes) to be distributed to those affected by the earthquake disaster under winter conditions.
Urgent response and alleviation of the suffering of the Syrians affected by the earthquake by providing urgent shelter and food materials and securing needs in light of the harsh winter conditions.
